issues.issue: Investments are printed on their own line, but beginning_investments/ending_investments are null and the line 3 / line 28 subtotals (cash + investments) are used as beginning_cash/ending_cash. This is defensible because those subtotals are what the statement rolls forward, and the notes say so. Under a strict reading, cash would be line 1/26 only, with investments filled in separately.
